CustomField.description: Short code for reports and other systems (Moodle, n8n, file names), e.g. RTS-FY27-CY1.
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISBLANK(Short_Code__c), ISBLANK(pmdm__StartDate__c), ISBLANK(Fiscal_Cycle__c)), NULL, UPPER(TRIM(Short_Code__c)) & "-" & Fiscal_Year__c & "-CY" & TEXT(Fiscal_Cycle__c))
CustomField.label: Reporting Code
